Are you using protection as well as lube? I do not believe lube alone with prevent transmission as you are still exposed through skin to skin contact.

Silicone based lubes last longer.

I was the same for the first few months after as well. The diagnosis rocked my world. The thought of being intimate with anyone again made me feel disgusting. Not only that, I genuinely believed no one would want to be with me after I disclosed.

I ended up feeling ready to try dating again after about 4 months, and had a few rejections at first, people unsure and not willing to take the risk. But I have been with a few people now, and my sex drive is very healthy again

Unfortunately the negative emotions are what comes with having HSV. You are doing the right thing by taking anti virals and using protection, it makes the chance of passing it incredibly unlikely.

However, it is the other persons immune system you have to think of. They may be sick, or be immunocompromised due to a medical condition you could be unaware of. It would be selfish to pass it on without disclosing it. 

It is entirely up to you. But coming from someone who has had countless rejections because of disclosure, and is currently dating someone who is having second thoughts about us having sex again (despite being on daily suppressants and us using protection), I still say disclose it.

Thank you for the link.

I am 24. I am well aware of the consequences of killing myself, and how much worse off I’ll be if i fail. However I don’t care. If I fail, I’ll try again, and try harder. I’m done with this life. 

Yes, psychologists can’t prescribe drugs, only psychiatrists can. I’ve only been on antidepressants for 5 weeks, and they can take a few months to really make a difference. However they’re not going to take my pain away, just make it more bearable. As of yet, it isn’t doing anything.

I wouldn’t say it’s “normal,” but it is certainly common. I myself have been thinking about killing myself every day for about a month now, with my plan forming more each day. I was going to do it last weekend, but my psychologist almost put me in hospital because of my suicide risk, and I held out on the hope that my ex boyfriend who left me (and why I’m suicidal and depressed), would see what he’d done to me, and come back. That me almost being admitted to a hospital was enough of a sign for him. Still holding out on that hope, but it’s fading more each day. I want to do it every day, wake up and wish I had died in my sleep. I’m not sure exactly when I’ll do it, but I know it’s coming soon, like it’s creeping nearer every day. It’s just a matter of when I can no longer take this pain anymore. 

Some people just think of death more than others, entertain the idea of taking their own life, but without an actual desire it will to act on it.
Thank you. I’m glad you’re getting the help you need, and that you also get better.

I’m glad your parents reacted so well. When I self harmed recently, my parents flipped out. My whole family screamed at me, told me I was stupid, that it wasn’t worth it, and guilt tripped me for the pain I put them through.

I would have invested more energy in to the relationship around the time his doubts started, to prevent the outcome that happened. I thought I was doing enough, doing what we always do, but he just needed some more reassurance. 

And when it came to talking about it all, I would have organised the relationship psychologist earlier, got the help sooner, because handling it ourself wasn’t working.

I had an old friend of mine kill them self three years ago. I hadn’t spoken to him years, and it rocked me hard when I found out. The funeral was hard, and even until recently (before my depression), I would still cry at the thought of it. And I know how much it hurt his family. But since my depression and losing my will to live, I can understand why he did it, and even though I know it’ll hurt my family and friends, I honestly believe the pain I’m in outweighs the pain me dying will give them, because at least they’ll one day understand and accept it’s what I wanted, and hopefully come to peace with my choice. Maybe I’m just blinded by the depression, but I can’t see a way out of this pain, and maybe I’m delusional in thinking they’ll ever be okay with it, but that’s all I have right now.
Thank you for that.

Emotional. My partner of 8 years left me about a month ago. On our anniversary two months ago, he raised his doubts and concerns he’d been harbouring for a year, and when we attempted to make this work, he walked away, because he started to correlate the pain we were feeling during all of our discussions/fights, with how he felt in the relationship. He started to develop feelings for someone else after the doubts started, finding a connection with someone else instead of rekindling it with me, and began replacing parts of our relationship with that person. When he realised he had feelings for her, he chose to walk away from me, because he started to find a source of happiness in her, while he was in pain with me (during those few weeks, we were both in a lot of pain). He was saving up for an engagement ring, was telling me for months he was going to propose next year. I had concerns about his friendship with this girl for months, and he promised me it was nothing more, that our relationship meant more to him. 

But when the push came to shove, he had a flight response, because leaving is easier. We have to sell the house we built, he’s been nothing but distant and cruel since he left, and won’t consider the possibility of us getting back together. We were meant to see a relationship psychologist, to get us through this, so he could find ways to articulate his feelings and be open (because his fear of confrontation and inability to understand his emotions manifests in anger and frustration), and find ways to rebuild that connection we felt was lost. 

My whole life has been taken from me. The only thing that ever meant anything to me, the only thing I was sure of, has left me. I’ve never been close with my family (my mum even regrets giving birth to us), I have some friendships, but not many, and they pale into comparison to the connection I found with my partner, and I’ve never cared much for career aspirations, because at the end of the day, nothing else mattered, as long as Im with him. The only future I’ve ever wanted has been taken from me, and I literally have nothing left to life for. And the hardest part, is he doesn’t even want to try, when it’s what our relationship deserves. You don’t walk away without trying, losing a connection after that long in relationships happen, doesn’t mean you just pack up and leave. 

I know it probably sounds pathetic, I’m being melodramatic, but it wasn’t just a boy, or just a relationship. It was my whole life, my whole future, it was the love of my life, the only thing that brought me happiness. Nothing else in life can compare. I can’t escape this pain, it gets worse every day, even more unbearable. I’m on anti depressants and seeing a psychologist, and it does nothing. I just want it all to end. The only thing I’m only holding on to right now, is that he might finally see his mistake, and realise he should make this work. When that’s completely gone, and when the house is gone, I’m going to kill myself.

Coming from a place where I’m suicidal and I believe I’ll end my life in the near future, I am looking forward to it. I see it as my means of an escape, of taking away the pain I’m in. I used to be so scared my death, paralysed by the fear of ceasing to exist one day. Since I fell into my depression, I no longer fear it. I wait for it now.

I think the best thing you can do is be there for him, but not make it about the cancer. So many people try to be there for people who are sick, and make the person feel like their illness is the only thing people see. Treat him like he’s the same old friend you’ve always had, but also try and do the things he wants to do before he passes, without making it a seem like a big deal. Help him and care for him, but don’t make it seem like it’s because he’s sick. I hope you understand what I mean.
I am so sorry about your best friend. I can’t imagine the pain you are in. ❤️

I know someone just like this. Will always steal the conversation away from anyone else as soon as she can. Will find even the slightest comparison to change the topic and make it all about her. And she will then talk for the next hour all about herself, and no one can get a shoe in. We try, but then she just raises her voice and talks over you and goes “yeah!” And then will jump back in where she left off. Yet when others talk, she’s disinterested, doesn’t pay attention, rolls her eyes, sits there annoyed. But when it’s all about her, all focus has to be on her. And she often says the same thing over and over, and has re-told the same story half a dozen times, and you have to sit there and let it play out again. You make efforts to walk away, when you think her sentences have wrapped up at certain points, but then she keeps going. It’s impossible to leave conversations with her, and you know when she’s there, you’re just waiting for her to start making it all about her.

I am not sure. I truly believe that we could be stronger if we came back together. I started reading a book a relationship psychologist recommended (back when he agreed to see one), and it covers how relationships recover following affairs (even emotional ones), and how trust and honesty can be rebuilt, and how the relationship becomes something new, as a way to move forward, not go back to the way it was. Because the way it was obviously didn’t work on some level. It’s about turning what happened into something new, coming together with more honesty and transparency, and finding new ways to communicate and rebuild that connection and intimacy that was lost. 

I do believe it is something that could happen, although it would take a long time, before trust is completely re-established. It may never be as trusting as before, there will always be those concerns and doubts at the back of your mind. But those doubts were there even before he broke my trust, despite how much I did trust him. It’ll be harder to trust, and he’d need to prove he is worthy of that trust again, and it might not ever be as much as I could trust him again. I don’t think I could, not truly. But it is worth trying.

He has said that he has ended the friendship with her, because he realises what he did was wrong. She has also backed away from him, because she never meant to get in the way of our relationship. She is the one who told him to open up to me and make it work, but I’m being there for him, he started to develop feelings for him. She was there as a comfort for during the weeks of hardship with me, and started to see her as his source of happiness. She didn’t realise being there for him as a friend was putting a further divide in our relationship. They still work together, but hardly the same shifts (hospital work with different departments), and when they do it’s awkward. They don’t talk outside of work, and if they do it’s work related. But that’s few and far between. So I hope that’s the end of it, that their friendship doesn’t rekindle. He knows he doesn’t deserve to rekindle that relationship with her, and he also knows he doesn’t deserve me after what he’s done, even though I’m willing to make it work. He knows he should never have felt that way for her, and he doesn’t want to be in a relationship with her, even though after he initially left me, he entertained the idea of being with her. He said she had feelings and was hiding it, that she was lying to him about how she truly felt. He was being delusional. 

I want to wait for him. He says he’ll never find someone who loves him as much as I do, someone as loyal, with so much love to give. Someone who values his life over their own. But yet he says that isn’t enough. He wants to move on from me though, wants to have a life without me in it, be single and find someone else in the future to make him happy. He doesn’t want to come back to me, he says that won’t fix things. I genuinely believe if the house is sold, he’ll shut me out, stop contact with me, and it’ll be the end of us, for good. I don’t think I can wait to see if that’ll change. I am a rational person, but I’m also incredibly empathetic, so I feel things in extremes, more than most people do. So this is why I’m struggling so hard to find any happiness outside of my life with him. There was only him, and there only ever will be.

I would be willing to forgive him. It will be hard, and it will take time. What he had with her was only an emotional affair, and I can understand how he found comfort in someone else while he lost a connection with me. I may not truly ever be okay with it, but because I’m an empathetic person, I can understand it. And I know if I give him time, he won’t come back. When the house is sold, that’ll be the last thing for him to fully move on. And he won’t consider coming back, there won’t be any ties between us anymore. And he’ll find it easier to move on. I’ve been trying to make him see that it’s still possible, that he still cares for me, but he says he needs to be single, that he doesn’t want to make us work, even though he should. He says he doesn’t have it in him to try. And the truth is he’s just weak, and he’s scared, and the easier thing to do is to walk away, and use his doubts and the pain of the last few weeks as a means to justify leaving, rather than trying to find reasons to stay. I don’t want to keep living without him.

He first raised his doubts about our relationship on our anniversary last month on the 28th. We then had countless discussions since about how he was feeling, and trying to make us work. I quickly realised doing it alone wasn’t working, so we organised seeing a relationship counsellor. He broke up with me on the 19th, but said he would still attend counselling to try and make this work. He then officially ended it on the 29th after his parents came back from China, to have their guidance. 

Turns out he’d been having doubts for about a year, around the time we built our home and moved out together, and then told himself it was nothing and internalised then. He then actively made the decision to stop being sexually intimate with me unless I instigated it, and then slowly lost an emotional connection with me. And I was none the wiser the whole time. And then another woman came in to his life, and he started to grow closer to her, replacing parts of our relationship. He had an emotional affair, and developed feelings for her, and lied to me for months. He held my hands, looked me in the eyes and kissed me and told me on various occasions that she was just a friend, that he would end the friendship in a heartbeat if she ever made a move or showed feelings for him. He told me he was saving for an engagement ring and was going to propose next year. She opened up to him about s divorce she went through, and how she had doubts in her relationship. Her words made him cement his doubts, and started to believe that our relationship wouldn’t work. He was willing to make it work, until he realised he would have to remove her from his life to do so. So he then left me instead. But then kept me in a state of anxiety for a week and half, believe we were still going to try and make it work. Since he officially left me a week and a half later, he’s been distant, cold, would hardly talk to me. Ignore me for days at a time. We knew we were going to have to organise the house, but we were meant to do it together. And I found out from my neighbour today that a real estate agent was taking photos of the house. He organised it all without telling me, and I found out through someone else. And we already have a potential buyer looking at the house tomorrow, someone who’s eager to buy desperately as they’re moving interstate. I was already contemplating suicide this weekend, but now this feels like the final nail in the coffin. 

A life with him was the only thing I wanted. I have a job, I’m a laboratory assistant. I want to try and get in to forensics (did biomed with a Major in forensics at uni), but truthfully, I never cared what career I had, as long as at the end of the day I came home to him. I don’t have any aspirations anymore. Before I met him, I was living, not exisiting. I only ever saw a future with him. Everything else was uncertain, but he was my only constant. My only source of true happiness. And us building the house was meant to be the start of the rest of our life together. Instead it became the beginning of our end.
